chk_method.label: accurate
chk_method.poster_evidence: ALBIREO is a detector-agnostic, codec-free wrapper that decides when detector calls can be skipped. It keeps a 10-dimensional Kalman filter per object and invokes the detector only when uncertainty exceeds a threshold. Skipped frames get predicted boxes at near-zero GPU cost, with a rescue mechanism and an empty-scene screen.
chk_method.reason: Located in the 'Abstract' section, this accurately describes the ALBIREO framework and its core components (Kalman filter uncertainty, rescue mechanism, and empty-scene screen).
